title: A Deadline for the Cover
author: Freya Marchetti
blurb: Coral Kavanagh, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
